<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 235.1395 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. The formula C₁₃H₁₈N₂O₂ matches this mass within a few millidaltons and predicts an M+1 isotopic intensity (~15 %) consistent with the observed 16.5 % peak, supporting the assignment.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H18O2N2</final_answer>
